intro.zh: 真实负载、泊松到达、Agent 回放和 YaRN 长上下文补测。
intro.en: Follow-up measurements for real workloads, Poisson arrivals, Agent replay and YaRN long context.

note.zh: 近 512K/1M 使用 YaRN 扩展，非原生窗口；近 1M 仅 8 组，不支持尾延迟推断。Agent 回放未评估真实工具执行或任务准确率。
note.en: Near-512K/1M uses YaRN extension, not the native window; the near-1M probe has only eight pairs and does not support tail estimates. Agent replay does not assess live tool execution or task accuracy.

intro.zh: 下表为报告中的代表性实测点；C 表示客户端并发。
intro.en: Representative measured points from the report; C denotes client concurrency.

notes.zh: 近 1M（999000 token）YaRN4 TP4 的 8 组冷热探针，native TTFT 中位数 524.90 / 7.05 秒，热命中 99.79%，检索码均正确。32K/512 C8 交付 TPOT P95 超过实验门限后停止扩档。
notes.en: Eight near-1M (999,000-token) YaRN4 TP4 cold/hot probes had native TTFT medians of 524.90 / 7.05 s, 99.79% hot-cache hit and correct retrieval codes. At 32K/512 C8, delivered TPOT P95 crossed the experiment threshold and higher concurrency was stopped.
